thread:
Anya: heads-up — seeing a spike in JIT provisioning failures from Okta this morning. ~20 users failed login with no role assigned, app assigned default 'viewer' instead of their Okta role. logs attached below.
Sam: ok can you paste the error snippet from the backend? did the assertion include the role attribute? @mohit fyi
Anya: here — from auth-service logs:
```
2024-08-04T09:12:22Z WARN provision_user failed user=uid:12345 error=MissingRequiredAttribute: 'redwood_role' assertion_attrs={email: "j.smith@cust.com", firstName: "Jane", lastName: "Smith", roles: "admin,infra"}
```
Note Okta is sending `roles` as a single comma string, we expect an array named `redwood_role`.
Sam: ah that explains it. Our SAML mapping expects `redwood_role` as multi-valued. Okta is configured to send Group > roles but the attribute mapping outputs a CSV string by default.
Mohit: yep — Okta's profile editor collapses multiple groups into a single attribute unless you set it to multi-value. Two options: (1) change Okta attribute mapping to send multiple values for `redwood_role` (preferred), (2) update auth-service to accept CSV and split on `,` as a fallback.
Luca: prefer making IdP authoritative, but we should be defensive. If we deploy a parsing fallback it'll avoid more user friction.
Anya: note: some customers rely on attribute `department` for feature gating. If we add CSV split we must ensure we don't accidentally parse a comma in a single role name. probably safe for our role names.
Sam: proposed quick fix in auth-service (pseudocode):
```
roles = assertion.get('redwood_role') or assertion.get('roles')
if isinstance(roles, str):
  roles_list = [r.strip() for r in roles.split(',') if r.strip()]
else:
  roles_list = roles
```
Also add metric `sso.role_parsed_as_csv` for a week to track.
OktaBot: provisioning.event user=uid:12345 status=PROVISION_FAILED reason=missing_attribute redwood_role
Mohit: two operational items:
- Reach out to affected customers with remediation steps and ETA for a fix
- Add an audit log entry when role assignment falls back to default: `audit: reason=missing_role fallback=viewer user=...` so we can triage faster
Luca: for rollout plan: feature-flag the CSV-parsing code, enable for 10% -> 50% -> 100% across regions. Also update the SAML integration docs with explicit instructions for Okta mapping: set attribute name `redwood_role` as 'Multi-Value' and map from Groups > Filter: /^redwood-/. Provide example mapping:
```
SAML attribute name: redwood_role
Format: Unspecified / MultiValue
Source: Groups (Filter: /^redwood-(.+)$/ -> $1)
```
Anya: I'll file a customer-facing incident note and add the audit log change request to the infra backlog. Sam, can you coordinate the Okta tenant change with partner support (some customers manage their own Okta)?
Sam: yep — will send a template message to customer admins: steps + verification command
Mohit: one more thing — check KMS-integrated keys for the auth-service secret rotation after deploy. If auth-service restarts and we lose transient cache, ensure JIT flows don't hit rate limits. Add a short runbook note.
Anya: good call. I'll add a short remediation runbook snippet to the incident thread.
Luca: sounds good. tagging @oncall for visibility :bell:
Anya: thanks everyone. pushing a quick PR with the CSV fallback behind a feature flag now.
Sam: thanks. keep us posted. :thumbsup:
